hero.title: The easiest way to run your bakery
hero.subtitle: Bakery System brings your staff, inventory, sales, and production together in one place — fast and simple. Now powered by AI, too.

about.title: What is Bakery System?
about.p1: Bakery System is a management system built specifically for small and mid-sized bakeries and pastry shops. It connects your whole team — owner, manager, baker, cashier, and driver — in one simple app.
about.p2: Many bakeries still run on notebooks, spreadsheets, or a handful of disconnected apps — which leads to mistakes, lost data, and wasted time. Bakery System solves that: schedules, inventory, sales, and reports all live in one place and update in real time.
about.p3: The system now also includes AI-powered demand forecasting and pricing recommendations, so you can plan not just for today, but for tomorrow too.

aboutUs.title: About us
aboutUs.text: Bakery System is a local project built to digitize bakeries and pastry shops across Uzbekistan. Our goal is to give small business owners a modern management tool that speaks their language.
